priorityList: Maintain Roll the Bones buffs; reroll if only one buff is active.
Cast Adrenaline Rush on cooldown to maximize uptime.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have 2 or more Roll the Bones buffs active.
Spend Combo Points on finishers when at 5 or 6 Combo Points (1 below maximum).
Use Dispatch as a finisher if Slice and Dice is not active.
Use Between the Eyes on cooldown as your priority finisher.
Use Killing Spree as a finisher.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher, or as a builder if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Dispatch as your default filler finisher.
Use Vanish to access Ambush if you lack Audacity or Opportunity procs.
Use Ambush as your primary builder when Audacity is active or when in Stealth/Vanish.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown for damage and energy generation.
Use Pistol Shot only with an Opportunity proc, prioritizing it at max stacks or to avoid overcapping Combo Points.
Use Sinister Strike as your default builder when no other procs are available.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities, ideally while Between the Eyes is active.
